features.name: Detect construction tricks
features.summary: 2-in-6 to notice new construction, sliding walls or sloping passages when searching.

features.name: Detect room traps
features.summary: 2-in-6 to find non-magical room traps when searching.

features.name: Infravision
features.summary: Sees heat in the dark to 60'.

features.name: Resilience
features.summary: Bonus to saves against poison, spells, and wands, rods and staves, by CON: 7–10 +2, 11–14 +3, 15–17 +4, 18 +5.

features.name: Dwarven clerics
features.summary: At the referee's option, dwarven clerics may only be NPCs.
